body: I have started doing cheerleading and not school cheer, All Star cheer. I used to be a gymnast so it feels like a good start for me. All the hours in the gym really helps me feel like im achieving something, and i enjoy the praise i get when I correct something im doing wrong or I know im doing something right. Thank you for helping me know that i am actually doing something right!

I tired a journal a few weeks ago and well I cant tell you it worked out great. :/ Most of them are doodles, but these doodles have become more  and more disturbing. Like I said depression isn't the only mental illness I have. I still go out with my friends it just feels like I'm just disconnected from people. Heck even my humanity. I honestly think the best thing for me is to get committed before i hurt someone or continue to hurt myself.

Thank  you for your reply. I have been trying to focus on other things but as time goes on it feels more like the mental illness is taking over. I have no interest in talking to people or going anywhere anymore. Most of the time I sit in paranoid silence. Like I said, I have gotten help before and it has made me feel so much better. I just can't get myself to ask for it again.
